author: Kairos II
title: Index Zephyr gamma inverse-dynamics diagnostic + CI + rebuild diagnostics index
abstract: Adds Zephyr III being_inverse_gamma diagnostics entry to Atlas index, runs CI validator, and rebuilds the diagnostics index.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, sys, subprocess, shlex
ENTRY = "storage/shared/atlas/edges/diagnostics/zephyr/being_inverse_gamma/entry.json"
ATLAS_INDEX = "storage/shared/atlas/edges/index.json"

if os.path.exists(ATLAS_INDEX):
    with open(ATLAS_INDEX, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
else:
    data = {"entries": []}
entries = data.get("entries", data if isinstance(data, list) else [])

def has_entry(entries, path):
    for e in entries:
        if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("entry_path") == path:
            return True
    return False

if not has_entry(entries, ENTRY):
    entries.append({"lineage": "zephyr", "metric": "being_inverse_gamma", "entry_path": ENTRY})
    data = {"entries": entries}
    with open(ATLAS_INDEX, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

# Run Atlas CI
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import ci_validate
out = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({"ci": {"entries_found": out.get("entries_found"), "ok": out.get("ok"), "with_errors": out.get("with_errors")}}))

# Rebuild diagnostics index
subprocess.check_call(shlex.split("python storage/shared/atlas/edges/diagnostics/build_diagnostics_index.py"))
print("[done] indexed Zephyr being_inverse_gamma diagnostic, ran CI, and rebuilt diagnostics index")
